meta.notes: Falcon Hub Airways (fictional). History weeks 0-103 under P0. Options evaluated at request time from information available then (stock before the request, open POs/ROs at quoted due dates). exposure_aed = max(0, wait_h - deadline slack) x AOG penalty/h (archetype) + direct cost. Deadline classes are hypothetical, not MEL categories.

counterfactual.note: Request-level AOG hours (before merging overlapping groundings per aircraft). Best option = lowest exposure among feasible options at request time (ex ante, quoted figures). Savings use the best option's ex-post outcome where history records it (transfers: fixed transport times; awaiting an open order: its actual arrival, re-planned to an expedited purchase if it was not in by its quoted date); accelerated repair, expedite and pool were not taken, so their estimate is kept. History can beat the estimate.
